capture.title: BTicino F454 with 99-zone Central Unit and subordinate zones (setpoints, modes, protection frames)
capture.abbreviation_note: Hand-transcribed debug log excerpts from physical F454 gateway testing. Includes setpoint writes, OFF/AUTO mode writes, central unit protection switches, and zone responses.

frames.note: Central unit reports mode 'heat' at setpoint 17.0 C after being set natively
Central unit setpoint written from Home Assistant to 16.5 C
Central unit confirms mode 'heat' at 16.5 C
Season switch on central panel turned to 'Estate' (summer thermal protection)
Zone 3 follows central unit into protection
Zone 3 reports thermal protection setpoint 35.0 C
Season switch on central panel turned to 'Inverno' (winter antifreeze)
Zone 3 follows central unit into antifreeze
Zone 3 reports antifreeze setpoint 7.0 C
Zone 1 reports antifreeze setpoint 10.0 C
Failing setpoint write without '#' on subordinate zone 3 (fails every time on F454)
Successful setpoint write with '#' on subordinate zone 3 to 16.0 C
Zone 3 confirms local target temperature 16.0 C
Successful setpoint write with '#' on subordinate zone 3 to 14.5 C
Zone 3 confirms local target temperature 14.5 C
Successful setpoint write with '#' on subordinate zone 11 (offset -3.0 C applied, wire target 17.0 C)
Zone 11 confirms local target temperature 14.0 C
Failing OFF mode write without '#' on subordinate zone 3 (retries and fails on F454)
Successful OFF mode write with '#' on subordinate zone 3
Zone 3 confirms mode set to 'off'
Zone 3 confirms mode set to 'off'
Successful AUTO mode write with '#' on subordinate zone 3
Zone 3 confirms mode set to 'heat'
